title: Accurate prediction of functional states of cis -regulatory modules reveals the common epigenetic rules in humans and mice
authors: Ni P; Moe J; Su Z
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习预测顺式调控模块的功能状态，涉及转录因子结合数据但未聚焦TF-DNA三维互作建模，方法可迁移但深度不足。
abstract: We proposed a two-step approach for predicting active cis -regulatory modules (CRMs) in a cell/tissue type. We first predict a map of CRM loci in the genome using all available transcription factor binding data in the organism, and then predict functional states of all the putative CRMs in any cell/tissue type using few epigenetic marks. We have recently developed a pipeline dePCRM2 for the first step, and now presented machine-learning methods for the second step. Our approach substantially outperforms existing methods. Our results suggest common epigenetic rules for defining functional states of CRMs in various cell/tissue types in humans and mice.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种两步法，用于预测细胞/组织类型中的活性顺式调控模块（cis-regulatory modules, CRMs）。首先，利用生物体内所有可用的转录因子结合数据，预测基因组中CRM位点的图谱；随后，借助少量表观遗传标记，预测所有推定CRM在任何细胞/组织类型中的功能状态。我们近期已开发出用于第一步的流程dePCRM2，并在此提出了用于第二步的机器学习方法。我们的方法显著优于现有方法。研究结果表明，在人类和小鼠的不同细胞/组织类型中，存在定义CRM功能状态的共同表观遗传规则。
